comment: Quote cards taken from the books SPARK already recommends (owner decision, Oct 2026 — option A). Every quote is a VERBATIM sentence from that book's Gutenberg text; this file stores only a `match` prefix, and the ingest re-fetches the book and pulls the exact sentence from the source, so a quote can never drift from the book it claims to come from. `actionLine` is written per quote (not per author). If a `match` is not found verbatim in the book, the ingest fails loudly instead of publishing a paraphrase.

quotes.chapter: EFFECT OF THOUGHT ON HEALTH AND THE BODY
quotes.match: If you would protect your body
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: no screens for the last 20 minutes before bed.

quotes.match: Men imagine that thought can be kept secret
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: name one habit you repeat daily, and decide whether you want it to become your life.

quotes.match: Thoughts of doubt and fear never accomplished
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: write the worst case on paper, then the one step you can take today.

quotes.match: You cannot waste the next hour
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: protect the next hour from your phone before anything else touches it.

quotes.match: If you imagine that you will be able to achieve your ideal
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: plan the next hour, not the next month — then start the first task.

quotes.match: You can turn over a new leaf every hour
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: when an hour goes badly, take the next one and start clean.

quotes.match: Resolve to perform what you ought
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: write the one decision you already made, then do it before noon.

quotes.match: Let all your things have their places
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: give your phone, keys and wallet one fixed place — and one fixed time to plan.

quotes.chapter: BUSINESS SUCCESS AND FIRST PUBLIC SERVICE
quotes.match: The present little sacrifice of your vanity
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: send the message you were waiting to send, without the extra paragraph.

quotes.match: You must first know what people need
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: ask one person what they can't get, then solve exactly that.

quotes.match: Young man, remember if you know what people need
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: ask one person what they need, and write down what you could build for them.

quotes.match: No matter how poor you may be
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: do the one money task you've been avoiding, before you feel ready.

quotes.match: Riches secured on the competitive plane
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: write down what you want your money for, before you chase more of it.

quotes.match: Demand not that events should happen as you wish
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: write one thing you can't control today, and one thing you can.

quotes.match: Upon every accident, remember to turn toward yourself
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: when something goes wrong, name the skill of yours that would fix the next one.

quotes.match: If you would improve, be content to be thought foolish
quotes.actionLine: Try this today: do one small useful thing today, without telling anyone about it.
